_comment: Template for YOLOX/YOLOv8 with fused DVS+Radar PNG images
_target: YOLOX, YOLOv8 (fused DVS histogram + radar point cloud)

_key_flags.fuse_dvs_radar_png: true - Create fused 3-channel images (2 DVS polarity + 1 radar)
_key_flags.fused_modality_name: Name for the fused modality output (default: {dvs_source}_radar)
_key_flags.fusion_dilation: Dilation kernel size for radar before fusion (default: 5)
_key_flags.filter_classes: List of class names to filter (e.g. ['person'])

_comment: Radar source for fusion - required when fuse_dvs_radar_png is true
